title: pilosella peleteriana
intro: Pilosella peleteriana, commonly known as Devil's Bane, is a flowering plant species within the dandelion family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate various health issues such as digestive problems and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. Therapeutically, Pilosella peleteriana has been used to treat conditions such as eczema, acne, and gastrointestinal disorders, and it is also used in the treatment of wounds and skin irritations.
